decks.notes: The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to control the game early on with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Sheoldred's Edict, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, while also maintaining card advantage through cards like Baleful Strix and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The mana base is built to support the deck's tempo strategy, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo - Show and Tell deck is to quickly ramp up mana with Lotus Petal and lands like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors, then use Show and Tell to put powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play for free. Sneak Attack can also be used to cheat creatures into play. The deck includes counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm for protection, as well as card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to draw into combo pieces. Burning Wish is included for additional versatility and access to sideboard cards.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence through aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck utilizes a low mana curve and a mix of disruptive and evasive threats to apply pressure on opponents early in the game. By efficiently using powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and a strong mana base featuring dual lands like Island','','');">Volcanic Island and Underground Sea, the deck aims to outpace opponents and close out games swiftly.

The deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats of its own. By combining aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Skyclave Apparition with powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude, the deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent. Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard help search for key equipment pieces like Kaldra Compleat, while Aether Vial allows for quick deployment of creatures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds a versatile option for late-game value.

The main concept of this Bant Control deck is to maintain a strong control over the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage through powerful planeswalkers and card draw effects. The deck focuses on controlling the board while setting up for powerful late-game threats such as Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. By utilizing a mix of interaction and card advantage, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue opponents, ultimately leading to victory through superior resource management and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing mana ramp to quickly generate large amounts of mana through Cloudposts and Tron lands, allowing the player to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul. Karn, the Great Creator is a key piece of the control aspect, shutting down opponent's artifacts and activating deadly combos with cards like Karn's Sylex. Crop Rotation and Once Upon a Time help find key lands and pieces, while cards like The One Ring and Disruptor Flute provide additional control and utility. The deck aims to overpower opponents with its efficient mana ramp and big threats.

The main concept of this deck revolves around quickly assembling the necessary cards to combo off and unleash powerful spells like Soul Spike and Necrodominance. It utilizes a mix of fast mana generation with cards like Cabal Ritual and Dark Ritual, disruption with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask, and powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Ancient Cellarspawn. The goal is to efficiently control the game until you can go off and overwhelm your opponent with a burst of powerful spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into play by utilizing cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It takes advantage of graveyard recursion and powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently use graveyard recursion spells to cheat out powerful creatures ahead of schedule and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Unmask. The deck aims to win the game by quickly establishing a strong board presence and controlling the game from there.

The deck focuses on utilizing fast mana accelerants and tutors to assemble a lethal combination of spells to win the game in a single turn. By generating a large amount of mana through rituals and artifacts, the deck can easily storm off and cast a high-impact spell like Tendrils of Agony to drain the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Wishclaw Talisman provide additional tutors to find key combo pieces.

The key strategy of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer, while also quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures to apply pressure. The deck also features mana acceleration with Grim Monolith and Lotus Petal to help get ahead on board early on. The Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin provide additional mana sources to cast the deck's powerful threats. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruptive spells and fast, powerful creatures.

This deck is focused on quickly deploying aggressive Goblin creatures and overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creature swarm and direct damage. The key strategy is to use cards like Aether Vial and Goblin Lackey to put Goblins into play for free, while also utilizing cards like Munitions Expert and Sling-Gang Lieutenant to deal damage to the opponent's creatures and life total. The deck also includes cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee for additional card advantage and board presence. The mana base is optimized for fast and consistent casting of Goblin spells.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo between Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible Marit Lage token quickly and efficiently. The deck includes numerous ways to tutor for or protect these key combo pieces, such as Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Green Sun's Zenith. Additionally, the deck runs disruption in the form of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as utility lands like Maze of Ith and Karakas to control the board and protect the combo.

The primary focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and lock them out of playing their spells using cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void. By quickly ramping out powerful threats like Simian Spirit Guide and Fury, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game before they can recover. With strong removal options like Shatterskull Smashing and Sundering Eruption, the deck has the ability to deal with opposing threats efficiently and maintain board control. The aggressive nature of this deck makes it a formidable force in the Legacy format.

The deck focuses on cheating out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to accelerate the combo by reducing the cost of spells. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures, bypassing traditional mana costs. The deck utilizes card draw and manipulation to find the combo pieces efficiently and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on playing control by utilizing cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, Force of Will, and Stifle to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The main win condition is utilizing the synergy between Doorkeeper Thrull and Phyrexian Dreadnought to quickly end the game. The deck also includes various card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary cards. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and quickly close out with a powerful combo.

The main concept of this deck is to be an aggressive strategy focused on controlling the board with a mix of disruptive spells and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to pressure the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland and countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also features cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and card selection. Additionally, cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional reach and removal options.
